info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Consumer Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Tax Handling Update API facilitates the modification of tax handling settings for consumers based on specific parameters. This API allows businesses to adjust consumer profiles by applying changes to customer tax preferences as identified by {param1}. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and tax service providers aiming to optimize their tax processing systems. This endpoint is especially useful for ensuring compliance with evolving tax regulations or consumer-specific requirements.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the tax handling details for a specific customer identified by CUST-100045. Ensure that all necessary details are provided in the request body to successfully process the update.

requestBody.description: Updates the tax handling information for the specified customer. Ensure that all required fields are included to process the request successfully.

200.description: Successful update of the customer tax handling information.
